offering_description.value: Manufactures industrial packaging such as steel, plastic and fibre drums, intermediate bulk containers, and closures, plus containerboard and reconditioned containers. Sells to chemical, food, agricultural, building and other manufacturers worldwide. Also provides packaging reconditioning, blending and filling services.

primary_products.value: steel drums; plastic drums and jerrycans; intermediate bulk containers; fibre drums; closures and containerboard/uncoated recycled paperboard

primary_services.value: container reconditioning; packaging filling and blending; logistics and packaging supply chain services; container recycling and pickup

customer_segment.value: B2B: chemical, petroleum, food and beverage, agricultural, pharmaceutical and building materials manufacturers and producers

end_markets.value: chemicals; food and beverage; agriculture; petroleum and lubricants; building and construction; pharmaceuticals

revenue_model.value: product sales: industrial packaging, closures and paper products sold to manufacturers; service fees: reconditioning, filling, blending and logistics services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts steel, resin and recycled fibre into containers and paperboard, sold to industrial producers; service provider: reconditions used containers and provides filling and packaging services to industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Africa, operations in about 35 countries

specialization.value: related lines: steel, plastic and fibre containers, IBCs, closures, paper packaging and reconditioning services for industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to industrial manufacturers and global accounts; distributors / dealers: packaging distributors serving smaller customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: hazardous goods packaging standards (UN certification, DOT), food-contact rules and environmental regulations

notes: Paper packaging holdings may have changed recently; details of current portfolio are uncertain.
